title: Settings API host descriptor
description: One host of a settings API, installed as <datadir>/phosphor-works/<api>-hosts/*.json and read by PhosphorConfig::HostDirectory, which keys descriptors by the Id inside the file and does not check the file name. This schema is the author-time gate on the descriptors the tree ships, and it is stricter than the run-time parser. It refuses an unknown key, which the parser ignores. It requires BusName to be a D-Bus well-known name, where the parser only requires a non-empty string. The parser also checks something a schema cannot, that the variable starting ConfigPath resolves to an absolute path for the user running it.

Id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit. The second rule refuses a trailing line break, which the end anchor alone lets through in some regex dialects.

BusName.description: A D-Bus well-known bus name: two or more elements separated by periods, each of letters, digits, underscores and hyphens, and none starting with a digit.

ConfigPath.description: The settings file: one of the listed variables, then one or more path segments. An empty segment, a . or .. segment and an ASCII control character (U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F) are refused.

Desktops.description: XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP entries the host serves, compared ignoring case.
